No third-party firmware bytes fetched or committed.

items.name: LILYGO T-Lora C6
items.scope: 已实现 GPIO9 BOOT、GPIO7 低有效绿灯和真实 SPI 路由的 SX1262 数字命令／数据包；RX15/TX14、复位、BUSY 与 DIO1 独立验证，未模拟真实射频传播。
items.scopeEn: Exact T3-C6 V1.0 GPIO and existing SX1262 digital command/packet subset through SPI2, GPIO NSS, reset, BUSY, DIO1 and mode-specific RX/TX switch gating. No physical RF propagation.

chronology.notes: Earliest dated hardware version explicitly listed in the official Version History. This is the manufacturer documentation date, not independently verified retail launch; undated and preview variants remain separate.

unsupported: No RF propagation, link budget, antenna gain, modulation waveform, FSK, CAD or regulatory model; host packet input is explicit digital stimulus.
No Wi-Fi/BLE/802.15.4 network or analog power/battery behavior.
External I2C devices are not fabricated. Firmware must explicitly drive NRST high in this profile; high-impedance module reset bias is not characterized.
LED uses routed software GPIO, not a PWM brightness model. Factory firmware startup remains unverified.

conflicts.resolution: Example defines LED_ON HIGH but only toggles in operation. Schematic VDD3V3→R47→LED1→GPIO7 proves active-low; electrical schematic is used.
Hardware Markdown table calls GPIO23 DIO0; exact example and S62F schematic label it DIO1. DIO1 is implemented.

radio.scope: LoRa digital subset only; DIO2 output and RF analog circuit are not modeled

memoryEvidence.flash: Official T3-C6 hardware table: ESP32-C6-MINI-1U,4MB Quad-SPI

factoryFirmwareInvestigation.notes: Official sender/receiver and Ping/Pong binaries are discovered. Their presence does not prove factory identity or successful boot; no binaries mirrored.

items.name: LILYGO Watch-Keyboard-C3 V1.0
items.hardwareRevision: Watch-Keyboard-C3 V1.0 keyboard accessory (H562); no bundled T-Watch MCU/display is simulated
items.scope: 仅提供官方确认的 ESP32-C3 MCU／SRAM／UART0 虚拟控制台调试；4MB Flash 是模拟配置，实板容量未知。键盘矩阵、按键、灯、附带音频／马达模块及 T-Watch 主机均未模拟。
items.scopeEn: Verified ESP32-C3 MCU/SRAM/UART0 virtual-console diagnostics only. The 4MB Flash allocation is a simulation setting; physical capacity is unknown. No keyboard matrix, button/LED mapping, included motor/audio accessory or paired T-Watch device is invented.

chronology.notes: Official Shopify published_at is a provisional listing-order proxy, not a confirmed hardware release. It can reflect republishing and software-preloaded editions; created_at is retained separately.

pins.keyboardConnector: Q10 ROW1..7/COL1..5 labels do not establish ESP32 GPIO mappings

memoryEvidence.notes: Official listing establishes ESP32-C3 identity, not external memory capacity. Four MB is an explicit diagnostic allocation with no claim about the Flash chip on the PCB. PSRAM allocation is zero in the C3 model; physical external-memory BOM remains unresolved.

researchGaps: No exact C3 firmware or schematic mapping connector ROW1..7/COL1..5 to MCU GPIO was located. Connector pin numbering is not a GPIO matrix.
External flash part marking is not legible and official listing does not specify its capacity; no4MB assumption.
Official T-WATCH-Keyboard repository uses LILYGO_WATCH_2019_WITH_TOUCH, not this C3 accessory. Its source and case STL are not substituted.
unsupported: Keyboard matrix connector labels are not GPIO numbers. No matrix key, BOOT-button or LED pin is exposed until exact wiring is found.
UART0 output is the existing virtual console of the C3 peripheral model, not proof of physical connector/USB converter routing.
Motor/MIC/speaker accessory, matrix scanner/keyboard protocol, paired T-Watch display/touch and RF/network are unmodeled.
No exact factory firmware, full ESP-IDF application boot or real hardware behavior was verified. The native test executes an original RV32I SRAM program without ROM stubs.

conflicts.resolution: The older repository selects LILYGO_WATCH_2019_WITH_TOUCH and is not a source of C3 accessory GPIO/memory. Its keyboard firmware and STL are not substituted.

checked: Exact Shopify description and full resolution official photos
Official organization code/repository searches for exact Watch-Keyboard-C3 spelling and C3 keyboard sources
factoryFirmwareInvestigation.notes: Exact product/photos and official organization repositories/code were searched. No exact C3 accessory factory recovery image was located; older T-WATCH-Keyboard examples are rejected as a different hardware target.
